pages.title: How to Use Rods
pages.text: Most rods have two ways of use:$(li)$(thing)On yourself$() — hold it and right-click$(li)$(thing)On others$() — right-click while sneaking towards your target$(br2)A rod used on someone stays inside them, and can be pulled back out with the $(item)Retriever$().$(br2)Each use is counted on the item itself. Don't ask why. It's just precise.

pages.title: Lubrication Matters!
pages.text: Forcing things in while dry will hurt, meow! (°ﾛ°٥)$(br2)Eating a $(item)Lubrication Book$() grants yourself a long-lasting $(#FF69B4)Lubricated$() effect, making playtime much smoother afterwards.$(br2)$(#FF69B4)It works without lube... but you'd better use some!$()

pages.title: Requirements
pages.text: $(thing)JustARod$() requires $(#FF69B4)toNeko$() — core mechanics such as nekos, estrus and pregnancy all come from it.$(br2)Installing $(item)Patchouli$() is recommended so you can read this very book, meow! (You're reading it, so you're all set~)
